title: Hotel Activity across the House and the Carry Uplift on Air Ticket Fare Brands
content:
Room charges a traveller has run up across the house bear on the value standing for a carry forward onto a fresh travel credit voucher under Air Ticket Fare Brands. Two things are read: the room charges posted to the traveller's Hotel Rate Plans stays over the twelve months to the handling date, taken as the total of those posted room charge lines, and whether an active Wanderlane Traveller Club card stands on the traveller's profile. The house-spend band is 1500.00 US dollars.

| Room charges posted over the last twelve months | Active club card on the profile | Uplift added to the value standing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| At or above 1500.00 US dollars | Yes | 0.08 is added to the value standing |
| Above nothing but below 1500.00 US dollars | Yes | 0.04 is added to the value standing |
| Above nothing | No | 0.02 is added to the value standing |
| Nothing posted | Immaterial | No house uplift is added to the value standing |

**Both sides of the house-spend band.** Room charges of exactly 1500.00 US dollars over those twelve months stand at the band, and with an active club card on the profile the uplift added to the value standing is 0.08; room charges of 1499.99 US dollars stand below the band, and with an active club card the uplift added to the value standing is 0.04. The same 1499.99 US dollars with no active card on the profile carries an uplift of 0.02 added to the value standing, as would room charges of 4000.00 US dollars with no active card. Where no room charges at all stand posted to the traveller's stays over those twelve months, no house uplift is added to the value standing.
